criteria.notes: Downtown wayfinding: illustrated city map, searchable destination list, language switch, directional guidance and selected-destination detail. The touch keyboard passes the shared keyboard conformance suite: focus retention on every control, disabled honoured, and no doubled space.
Veszprem tourist-map concept retained: the authored illustrated plan as the visual base with an overlay list rather than a redrawn map.
Reads as a civic orientation point; the map base, QR panel and bilingual switch are specific to this deployment.
Destination names and the board title hold their roles; map labels belong to the authored artwork and are unchanged.
Custom-theme and compact scenarios preserve list contrast and selection emphasis against the map base.
Long-title, long-destination-list and long-destination-selected scenarios wrap names completely without ellipsis.
Map and list divide the surface at both sizes; the keyboard scenario overlays without displacing the map, and the empty state substitutes an explicit message.
The illustrated map renders sharply at 1366x768 and 1920x1080 with the QR and brand marks intact.
Reference-led map wayfinding is structurally distinct from every other example in the portfolio.
